cases.name: Ana Gutierrez-Cedano
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Born in Santo Dominigo, Dominican Republic on May 1, 1966. Ana was very faithful to her church, Maranatha Pentecostal Church in Mountville. She would walk into church with a smile on her and leave church with a bigger smile on her face. She was blessed to attend church the afternoon prior to passing away. She graduated from the Mizpa Bible Institute in 2016. She enjoyed singing, cooking and sewing. She loved her two grandsons and spending time with them. She always had a smile on her face and enjoyed making others laugh and to be happy."
